affixes.afflicted.description: While in combat, afflicted souls periodically appear and seek the aid of players.
affixes.afflicted.name: Afflicted
affixes.awakened.description: Obelisks throughout the dungeon allow players to enter Ny'alotha and confront powerful servants of N'Zoth. If a servant is not dealt with, they must be faced during the final boss encounter.
affixes.awakened.name: Awakened
affixes.beguiling.description: Azshara's Emissaries are present throughout the dungeon.
affixes.beguiling.name: Beguiling
affixes.bolstering.description: When any non-boss enemy dies, its death cry empowers nearby allies, increasing their maximum health and damage by 20%.
affixes.bolstering.name: Bolstering
affixes.bursting.description: When slain, non-boss enemies explode, causing all players to suffer 10% of their max health in damage over 4 sec. This effect stacks.
affixes.bursting.name: Bursting
affixes.challengers_peril.description: The timer is increased by 90 seconds, but dying subtracts 15 seconds from time remaining.
affixes.challengers_peril.name: Challenger's Peril
affixes.encrypted.description: Enemies throughout the dungeon possess relics of the First Ones. Destroy the relics to summon the First Ones' Automa and gain powerful bonuses, based on the order in which they were destroyed.
affixes.encrypted.name: Encrypted
affixes.entangling.description: While in combat, entangling vines periodically appear and snare players.
affixes.entangling.name: Entangling
affixes.explosive.description: While in combat, enemies periodically summon Explosive Orbs that will detonate if not destroyed.
affixes.explosive.name: Explosive
affixes.fortified.description: Non-boss enemies have 20% more health and inflict up to 20% increased damage.
affixes.fortified.name: Fortified
affixes.grievous.description: When injured below 90% health, players will suffer increasing damage over time until healed above 90% health.
affixes.grievous.name: Grievous
affixes.incorporeal.description: While in combat, incorporeal beings periodically appear and attempt to weaken players.
affixes.incorporeal.name: Incorporeal
affixes.infernal.description: Infernal Beacons can be found near some bosses. Activating a Beacon or engaging a nearby boss will trigger a Legion invasion.
affixes.infernal.name: Infernal
affixes.infested.description: Some non-boss enemies have been infested with a Spawn of G'huun.
affixes.infested.name: Infested
affixes.inspiring.description: Some non-boss enemies have an inspiring presence that strengthens their allies.
affixes.inspiring.name: Inspiring
affixes.lindormis_guidance.description: Lindormi guides players, weakening select non-boss enemies with Temporal Sands and preventing player deaths from reducing time remaining.
affixes.lindormis_guidance.name: Lindormi's Guidance
affixes.necrotic.description: All enemies' melee attacks apply a stacking blight that inflicts damage over time and reduces healing received.
affixes.necrotic.name: Necrotic
affixes.prideful.description: Players overflow with pride as they defeat non-boss enemies, eventually forming a Manifestation of Pride. Defeating this Manifestation greatly empowers players.
affixes.prideful.name: Prideful
affixes.quaking.description: Periodically, all players emit a shockwave, inflicting damage and interrupting nearby allies.
affixes.quaking.name: Quaking
affixes.raging.description: Non-boss enemies enrage at 30% health, becoming immune to crowd control other than interrupts.
affixes.raging.name: Raging
affixes.reaping.description: Non-boss enemies are empowered by Bwonsamdi and periodically seek vengeance from beyond the grave.
affixes.reaping.name: Reaping
affixes.relentless.description: Non-boss enemies are granted temporary immunity to Loss of Control effects.
affixes.relentless.name: Relentless
affixes.sanguine.description: When slain, non-boss enemies leave behind a lingering pool of ichor that heals their allies and damages players.
affixes.sanguine.name: Sanguine
affixes.shrouded.description: Nathrezim infiltrators have disguised themselves among enemies throughout the dungeon. Cartel Ta will reward you handsomely for assisting in their capture.
affixes.shrouded.name: Shrouded
affixes.skittish.description: Enemies pay far less attention to threat generated by tanks.
affixes.skittish.name: Skittish
affixes.spiteful.description: Fiends rise from the corpses of non-boss enemies and pursue random players.
affixes.spiteful.name: Spiteful
affixes.storming.description: While in combat, enemies periodically summon damaging whirlwinds.
affixes.storming.name: Storming
affixes.teeming.description: Additional non-boss enemies are present throughout the dungeon.
affixes.teeming.name: Teeming
affixes.thundering.description: Enemies have 5% more health. While in combat, players are periodically overcharged with primal power from Raszageth's unending storm. This power comes with great risk, and failure to discharge it quickly can have stunning consequences.
affixes.thundering.name: Thundering
affixes.tormented.description: Servants of the Jailer can be found throughout the dungeon and grant powerful boons when defeated. If a servant is not dealt with, they empower the final boss.
affixes.tormented.name: Tormented
affixes.tyrannical.description: Boss enemies have 25% more health and inflict up to 15% increased damage.
affixes.tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
affixes.unknown.description: The affixes for this week are not known yet.
affixes.unknown.name: Unknown
affixes.volcanic.description: While in combat, enemies periodically cause gouts of flame to erupt beneath the feet of distant players.
affixes.volcanic.name: Volcanic
affixes.xalataths_bargain_ascendant.desc: While in combat, Xal'atath rains down orbs of cosmic energy that empower enemies or players.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_ascendant.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Ascendant
affixes.xalataths_bargain_devour.descrip: While in combat, Xal'atath tears open rifts that devour the essence of players.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_devour.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Devour
affixes.xalataths_bargain_frenzied.descr: Non-boss enemies become frenzied at 30% health remaining, increasing their Haste by 40%, but increasing their damage taken by 20%.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_frenzied.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Frenzied
affixes.xalataths_bargain_oblivion.descr: While in combat, Xal'atath manifests crystals from the void that can be absorbed by enemies or players.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_oblivion.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Oblivion
affixes.xalataths_bargain_pulsar.descrip: While in combat, Xal'atath summons pulsars that orbit players.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_pulsar.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Pulsar
affixes.xalataths_bargain_voidbound.desc: While in combat, Xal'atath summons a Void Emissary that empowers nearby enemies.
affixes.xalataths_bargain_voidbound.name: Xal'atath's Bargain: Voidbound
affixes.xalataths_guile.description: Xal'atath betrays players, revoking her bargains while making deaths subtract 15 seconds from time remaining.
affixes.xalataths_guile.name: Xal'atath's Guile
